name: Bursant
description: Bursant was a planet in the galaxy which was the homeworld of the Bursantian species. During the Clone Wars, a group of Jedi and senators, including Jedi Masters Yoda and Mace Windu, and Senator Yarua, visited an archaeological dig site on the planet.
lead_paragraphs: Bursant was a planet in the galaxy which was the homeworld of the Bursantian species. During the Clone Wars, a group of Jedi and senators, including Jedi Masters Yoda and Mace Windu, and Senator Yarua, visited an archaeological dig site on the planet.
